title: Light fibre
description: Fine amber fibres bend around one moving pulse of light.
useCase: Network, sound, or optical technology identities that need a precise luminous texture.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Luminous curve rendering without blur post-processing; not a physical fibre-optics simulation.
look: Near-black field with a band of thirty-six fine amber-to-rust lines undulating across it, brightened by one soft golden highlight.
motion: Thirty-six sine-curved fibres undulate slowly while a Gaussian light pulse sweeps back and forth along them, brightening the strands it crosses; the bend slider scales wave amplitude.
adapt: Everything is in `FRAGMENT`: 36 fibres in the loop, wave speed `u_time*.12`, pulse sweep `.48*sin(u_time*.24+f*.5)` and colour `mix(vec3(.30,.11,.025),vec3(1,.68,.25),f)`; `u_control` (the bend range) scales amplitude. Keep the canvas lifecycle, pause button and fallback.
